name: browse_preview
description: Open the current project's live preview (localhost) in the Agent Browser. Use this to test web apps, games, and HTML pages you are building — you can then interact with the preview using browse_snapshot, browse_click, browse_type, etc. Optionally specify a file path (e.g. "index.html") to preview a specific entry point.

path.description: Optional file path relative to project root (e.g. "index.html", "src/app.html"). Defaults to root "/".
